verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's own CLI installs the same skill into two harnesses at once. Its docs say it adds instructions for Codex and Claude Code, and a hands-on dry run of `ultrametric init` previewed per-harness SKILL.md files under both .agents/skills and .claude/skills. Other agents connect only generically, through the remote MCP endpoint or the CLI, which share one hosted process service. Missing for 10: per-harness install or instructions for Cursor or any harness beyond Codex and Claude Code, and documentation of how the per-harness skill content differs.
